# VKP

Utilities for creating, analyzing, and converting VKP patches.

## Programs

- **[FFPatch](./ffpatch.md)**<br/>
  A program for comparing FullFlash images and working with VKP patches.
- **[Fullflash Comparer](./fullflash-comparer.md)**<br/>
  Creates a VKP patch based on the differences between the original and modified FullFlash.
- **[Hex2VKP](./hex2vkp.md)**<br/>
  A converter from Intel HEX to the VKP patch format for V_KLay.
- **[SLFC](./slfc.md)**<br/>
  A console program for comparing FullFlash images and creating VKP patches.
- **[VkpResolver](./vkp-resolver.md)**<br/>
  Places graphical VKP patches in a free area of the firmware without address overlap.
- **[VkpTracer](./vkp-tracer.md)**<br/>
  Moves the selected address range in a VKP patch and fixes references.
